bugs_found_by_testing_and_fixed: kill -9 of the service left the trainer alive holding the GPU (fixed: PDEATHSIG + pid file cleanup on restart; test_killing_the_service_does_not_leave_a_trainer_on_the_gpu)
Content-Length that is not a number returned 500 (now 400)
NUL character in a path/body/query returned 500 from PostgreSQL (now 400)
runner could claim another service's queued job or crash on a missing job directory (now only claims jobs whose directory it owns; stale ones fail)
real_gpu_tests: cancel a running job: GPU memory released
another process holds the GPU: job stays queued with free/needs reported, then runs when freed
5 consecutive real jobs: GPU back to baseline 4144 MiB each time, identical val perplexity 1.23
hardening_round_2.result: tests/studio 32 passed; whole suite 454 passed before the 3 GPU-threshold test fixes (ran with 3 llama-servers resident, so absolute thresholds were wrong, made relative); Chrome E2E 10/10

hardening_round_3.soak: 20 consecutive real LoRA jobs with 735 RAG asks interleaved: 0 errors, GPU drift 0 MiB, RAG ask p50 0.20 s / p95 0.66 s while training
hardening_round_3.leak_found_and_fixed: service RSS grew ~22 KiB per RAG search (register_vector on every new connection created never-freed adapter classes); fixed with a connection pool; 600 searches: +13.2 MiB -> +0.00 MiB; regression test fails on the old code (+8.8 MiB/400) and passes on the new
hardening_round_3.real_documents: real .docx (Vietnamese text + table) and .pdf (reportlab, DejaVu font) are extracted and answered through the API; scanned PDF refused with OCR hint; zip bomb refused (document expands beyond the size limit); truncated/corrupt/type-confused files are 400
hardening_round_3.limit_changed: indexing is synchronous at ~26 s per 1M characters (measured: 100k=2.6 s, 400k=10.4 s, 1M=25.8 s); per-document cap lowered from 5M to 1M characters so a request stays under a typical 60 s proxy timeout
hardening_round_3.result: full suite 467 passed / 32 skipped / 1 xfailed; Chrome E2E 10/10

hardening_round_4.gateway: HTTP server limits added (ReadHeaderTimeout 10 s, ReadTimeout 5 min, IdleTimeout 2 min, 64 KiB headers, deliberately no WriteTimeout for SSE/streaming); Go tests: slowloris cut off, 5-event stream outlives read timeouts; removing ReadHeaderTimeout makes the slowloris test fail

adapter_effect_on_llama_server.setup: 12 invented product names -> colours (5 paraphrases each, 60 rows), LoRA r16 300 steps (34 s) via the Studio, exported with GET .../adapter?format=gguf, loaded with llama-server --lora on Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0
adapter_effect_on_llama_server.correct_colour_with_adapter: 12/12 on seen wording, 12/12 on a NEW wording
adapter_effect_on_llama_server.control: asking about company 'Beta' instead of 'Alpha' ALSO gave the Alpha colours 12/12: the adapter memorised name->colour, it does not scope facts by context. For facts that change or depend on context use RAG.
adapter_effect_on_llama_server.caveat: tiny synthetic fact set; shows the training->export->serve chain works and changes answers, not that LoRA is a good way to store knowledge
